rules: Current manifest originals are actual retained physical paths, with immutable Git metadata for every identified governing snapshot.
Historical manifests are preserved raw and are not rewritten to pretend that their earlier logical source versions are current.
The two root verifier versions use their explicit retained-path-map.json transports; current helper is v3.
The source-only preparation predates both original angles; its queries and PDF render history remain historical evidence, not new executions.
